column1: # scripts/mutation_catchers.tsv — the recorded catching gate per mutant (D70).
# GENERATED by `scripts/mutation_test.sh --full`; do not hand-maintain the counts.
# An ordinary mutation_test.sh run tries a mutant's recorded gate FIRST and stops as soon
# as that gate fails, instead of running the whole gate set at every mutant. A line that is
# missing, stale or simply wrong only costs time: the mutant then gets the entire gate set
# before the harness will call it uncaught, so this file can never turn a survivor into a
# pass. It is harness metadata, not a fixture and not an input to the engine.
# catchers = how many gates failed against that mutant in the --full run that wrote this
# line. A 1 means that gate is the mutant's single point of failure: if it is ever weakened
# or deleted, the mutant is not covered by anything else.
